_about: Bed for the Doppler short (bin/vh music). 100 BPM (18 frames a beat at 30 fps), D major, stereo, room. The score starts 0.2 s into the film (tools/build_audio.sh delays it and shifts the beat map), so beat k is at 0.2 + 0.6 k s and the bar lengths put a bar head on every cut: S1 0.2–3.2 (5 beats) · S2 3.2–6.2 (5) · S3–S5 the pass 6.2–14.6 (4+4+6) · S6a 14.6–17.6 (5) · S6b 17.6–20.6 (5) · S7 20.6–24.8 (5+2; the mirror curve starts drawing on 20.6). The beacon pings (tools/foley.py) sit on these beats. Keep the melodic parts under ~700 Hz: the pings glide around A5 (740–1050 Hz) and the voice sits above the bass. Harmony follows the physics: approaching on I (bright), overhead on IV, receding on vi → ii (darker), and the tonic D lands on 23.6 with the first flat ping ('补偿后 ≈ 0'). Breath: S6a (strings, drone and a slower bass only, under the formula and the numbers; still loud enough to fill the pause between two lines). No score riser into S7: the layer riser's noise covered '再大 10 倍' and the Ka reveal; S6b builds with a kick on every beat instead.
